crossRefs.note: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!
As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so is my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great…
I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride. I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with…
For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy…
and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:
That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw…
How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people will be satisfied with my goodness,” says Yahweh.
For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the…
Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God.
Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled.…
Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

translations.web: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
translations.bsb: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
translations.kjv: O taste and see that the LORD is good: blessed is the man that trusteth
translations.asv: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good: Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.
